title: Tumelo e e Kafa Morago ga Setulo sa Bogosi
intro: Mewa e mengwe ga e lekwe ke molelo kgotsa morwalela, mme e lekwa ke kgatelelo e e bonya ya go nna mo teng ga ntlo ya segosi ya mogateledi. Setshwantsho seno se ne se eme fa thoko ga mmusi yo o neng a bolela gore o na le bomodimo mo bathong ba gagwe, mme lefa go ntse jalo a ne a ngaparela tumelo mo Modimong o le Mongwe wa Boammaaruri mo sephiring. Fa boineelo jwa bone bo ribololwa, pogiso e ne ya tla — mme le tsholofetso ya bomodimo e ne ya tla. A o ka fopholetsa gore yo ke mang?
clues: Ke ne ke nna kafa tlase ga borulelo jwa mmusi yo o maatla go gaisa botlhe wa naga ya gaetsho, mo boemong jo batho ba le mmalwa fela ba neng ba ka bo akanya.
Molekane wa me o ne a ema fa pele ga batho mme a ipolela gore ke modimo — mme pelo ya me e ne e le ya Morena a le Mongwe wa Boammaaruri.
Ke ne ke sebaseba dithapelo mo sephiring, ke tshaba kotlhao e e neng e tlela botlhe ba ba neng ba ganetsa molekane wa me.
Fa tumelo ya me e ne e senolwa, ke ne ka tshwarwa le go bogisiwa — le fa go ntse jalo leleme la me ga le ise le ko le bue lefoko la go sa dumele.
Ke ne ka tshololela Morena wa me mafatlha, ke kopa ntlo kwa Paradaiseng, kgakala le ditiro tsotlhe tse di sa siamang.
Ke nna Asiya bint Muzahim — mosadi wa ga Faro yo o neng a ganetsa Musa le Harun.

identity.label: Ke Mang?
options: Asiya bint Muzahim (Mosadi wa ga Faro)
Hawwa (Efa), mosadi wa ntlha
Sara, mosadi wa ntlha wa ga Ibrahim
Hagare, mmaagwe Isma'ile
Mmaagwe Maryam (mosadi wa ga Imran)
identity.answer: Asiya bint Muzahim (Mosadi wa ga Faro)

trial.label: Teko/Tiragalo
options: Go itshokela pogiso ka ntlha ya go gana go itatola tumelo
Go tshela mo teng ga mpa ya tlhapi e kgolo
Go aga araka e kgolo go falola morwalela
Go latlhelwa mo molelong o o tukang
Go bona lewatle le legolo le kgaogana
trial.answer: Go itshokela pogiso ka ntlha ya go gana go itatola tumelo

location.label: Elemente ya Botlhokwa
options: Ntlo e ba e agilweng mo Paradaiseng
Lore lo lo neng lwa fetoga noga
Areka e e rweleng dipara tsa sebopiwa sengwe le sengwe
Namane ya gauta e e neng e obamelwa ke morafe mongwe
Mokgwa o o neng o dirisiwa go fenya motlhabani yo mogolo
location.answer: Ntlo e ba e agilweng mo Paradaiseng

outcome.label: Botso
options: Go tlotliwa ka bonno mo Paradaiseng go bapa le basiami
Ba nwetse ka fa tlase ga makhubu mmogo le mophato wa bone
O ne a fisiwa ke molelo mme a bolokwa ka ntlha ya go tsereganya ga Modimo
E meditswe ke sebopiwa se segolo mme morago ga moo e bo e latlhelwa kwa lotshitshing lwa lewatle
E nnile motho yo o humileng go gaisa botlhe mo motlheng wa bone
outcome.answer: Go tlotliwa ka bonno mo Paradaiseng go bapa le basiami

arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًۭا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And Allāh presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people." (66:11)
